neighbours.label: Reports of a product defect being acted on: product 'recall(s)' and a flaw or vulnerability 'affecting' a product, not 'recall' as remembering
fire: The carmaker announced a recall of 30,000 vans over faulty brakes.
A dairy in Ohio has recalled its yogurt after mould was found.
Security researchers found a bug that affects millions of smart TVs.
The pet food recall was expanded to three more brands on Monday.
Hackers exploited a flaw affecting older versions of the browser.
Shoppers were told to return the toasters under the voluntary recall.
The vulnerability affects every router sold before 2019.
Regulators ordered the firm to recall the contaminated spinach.
quiet: I can barely recall the face of my first teacher.
The carmaker announced a new line of vans with wider seats.
She was deeply affected by the news of her friend's death.
He could not recall where he had parked the car.
A dairy in Ohio has launched a new yogurt with honey.
The drought affected farmers across the whole region.
Do you recall the song we sang at the wedding?
Shoppers were thrilled with the toasters on sale this week.

notes: Card: ' recall' x6, CVE, flaw, 'affects', 'vulnerabilities'. Probe: 'Food Safety Recall' 0.981, 'has recalled 840 cartons' 0.791, 'vulnerability that affected' 1.051, 'CVE... affects older routers' 0.693; memory recall 'can't recall the name' 0.025, 'tried to recall the words' 0.077. 'The update affected the colors' 0.524, so software 'affected' fires even without a defect; near misses use non-technical 'affected' and memory 'recall'.
